content.rendered:
The Hawks View Fun Run will take place on Friday, September 27 and includes our PreK-5th grade students. This is our largest fundraiser of the year and we appreciate your support! Can we beat last year’s goal?!  Let’s go Hawks!  

Envelopes and PledgeStar information were sent home on September 13th in backpacks.  All pledges are due by the end of the school day on Friday the 27th.  Pledges turned in late will not count towards prizes. Extra envelopes are available in the office if needed. Watch the Fun Run video for more information! 

Families are invited to attend and cheer on their child(ren) from the perimeter of the track. Volunteers will be  helping inside the track. We will have several check in tables down on the field. Parents should visit one of the tables to sign in and receive a visitor/volunteer sticker. We are looking forward to this fun event!  

Please be sure your child is dressed appropriately for the weather.  Wear layers, no open toe shoes, no crocs, etc.  Don’t forget sunscreen and water bottles!  

Classroom Fun Run times are:

  • 1st Gr – 8:15-8:50
  • Kinder & PreK – 9:05-9:40
  • 2nd Gr – 9:55-10:30
  • 4th Gr – 10:45-11:20
  • 3rd Gr – 11:35-12:10
  • 5th Gr – 12:25-1:00

All volunteers will need an approved background check before volunteering. Background checks take 7-10 business days to clear; links are at the bottom of this newsletter. Contact the office at 503-825-5400 to see if your approval has been received.
